import bpy,json
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
c=bpy.data.collections['Shipyard_COMBINED_Craft'];stones=[];sheets=[]
for ob in c.objects:
 if ob.type!='MESH':continue
 names=[m.name for m in ob.data.materials if m]
 if any('CutWeatheredStone' in n for n in names):
  stones.append({'name':ob.name,'dimensions':list(ob.dimensions),'bevels':[{'width':m.width,'segments':m.segments} for m in ob.modifiers if m.type=='BEVEL'],'bounds_world':[[float(x) for x in ob.matrix_world@__import__('mathutils').Vector(v)] for v in ob.bound_box]})
 if any('RivetedSheetSteel' in n for n in names):
  sheets.append({'name':ob.name,'dimensions':list(ob.dimensions)})
out={'stone_count':len(stones),'stones':stones,'sheet_count':len(sheets),'sheets':sheets}
p=Path(bpy.data.filepath).parent.parent/'captures/reference_style_audit_20261112/current_geometry_diagnosis.json'
p.write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
print('STONES',len(stones),'BEVELS',Counter(round(m['width'],4) for s in stones for m in s['bevels']),'SHEETS',len(sheets))
